fusions.name: Shallows Slap
fusions.desc: Slaps the flat of the staff down on standing water and throws it through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 11 damage to everything in it, knocks each target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Prod
fusions.desc: A level prod at a target up to 3.5 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 40% chance to leave it [Damped] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Off the Spinning Shaft
fusions.desc: You spin the staff overhead for 3 seconds. Blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Paddling Beneath
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
